$comment: Example runbook, not a --config file: mcp-prompts-http reads HOST, PORT, MCP_PROMPTS_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE and MCP_PROMPTS_ALLOWED_HOSTS from its environment. Start it as shown under 'server', then add 'client' on a desktop on the same tailnet. Tailscale encrypts the link; the bearer token and Host check are the server's own.

stateless.note: No initialize handshake is needed; every call except /health, /ready and /version carries the bearer token.
